lesson.text: Quick memory: what did Florence Nightingale's charts show? (Most of the illness could be stopped.) Today: helping, checking, patience, courage.
Henry Dunant got a whole town to help wounded soldiers of both sides. His book led to the Red Cross. His business later went wrong, but he kept going.
Katherine Johnson checked the computer's numbers for John Glenn's flight round the Earth. People trusted her careful work.
Yuan Longping searched rice fields for years. His team's hybrid rice gave much more rice, and is grown in many countries.
Savitribai Phule kept teaching girls even when people threw dirt at her. That took courage.
Success means many things: helping, finding out, teaching. And things going wrong is part of the story.
Try it in the Story Theatre: help Henry, Katherine and Yuan.
